title: Comment
description: A reader comment on a published content entry, as stored in D1 (outside the site graph), returned to people and agents, and exported (RFC-0007). It is not a graph node: it never enters a snapshot, a diff or a site bundle, and a content rollback never changes it. The record carries no personal data beyond the display name the commenter chose: an email address, an IP address or its hash, a user agent and a proof-of-work challenge live in separate columns and tables that this contract cannot express (additionalProperties: false), so no reader of the contract — Studio lists, MCP tools, exports — can leak them. Text is plain text; renderers escape it and turn only https links into anchors with rel="ugc nofollow noopener noreferrer".

nodeId.description: The content entry the comment belongs to, by id, so threads survive slug changes (RFC-0002).

parentId.description: The comment this one is nested under for display. Absent for a top-level comment. In v1 the tree is two levels deep: a parent is always top-level, and a reply to a reply is nested under the same top-level comment with `inReplyToId` pointing at the comment it answers.

inReplyToId.description: The comment this one answers when that is not `parentId` itself (a reply to a reply). Only with `parentId`, in the same thread.

source.description: Where the comment came from: `native` (the site's own form or Studio), `import` (an importer; see `origin`). `webmention` and `activitypub` are reserved for later RFCs and are refused by v1 writers.

labels.description: Advisory labels from rules, classifiers, agents and people. Labels never change what readers see; only a status change does.

editedAt.description: Set when the text changed after it was first stored (v1.1 edit window; staff replies edited in Studio).

CommentId.description: A comment id: `cmt_` and 6 to 32 letters or digits.

CommentStatus.description: Lifecycle. `pending` waits for a person (every guest comment starts here); `approved` is public; `hidden` is withdrawn and reversible; `spam` is never shown and is deleted after the retention period; `deleted` is a soft delete, hard-deleted after the retention period unless approved replies keep it as a tombstone.

CommentDisplayName.description: Plain text chosen by the commenter (or the staff member's name), NFC-normalised and trimmed by the server: 1 to 80 characters, no control characters, no bidirectional overrides, no surrounding whitespace.

CommentBody.description: The comment text. v1 has only `text`: plain text with line breaks, no markup. A later RFC may add a restricted Markdown format. Absent only when the text was deleted (status `deleted`, or an erasure that removed the text); the record then stays as a tombstone while approved replies hang under it.

text.description: NFC-normalised, CRLF turned into LF, trimmed: 1 to 5,000 characters. Tabs and line feeds are the only control characters allowed; bidirectional overrides are refused so a comment cannot disguise itself in Studio.

CommentAuthor.description: Who wrote the comment, discriminated by `kind`. There is deliberately no email, address or account handle here.

oneOf.title: GuestCommentAuthor
oneOf.description: A guest: only the display name they typed. Guest comments are always held for moderation in v1.

oneOf.title: ReaderCommentAuthor
oneOf.description: A verified reader (v1.1: email code or magic link on the site's own host). `readerId` is the site's reader account id, never the email.

oneOf.title: StaffCommentAuthor
oneOf.description: A reply on the site's behalf. It is always attributed to a person (`personId` is a staff actor id, `user_…`): an agent may draft the text (`draftedBy`), but a person approved it. `draftedBy` names the agent that drafted the text, when one did (shown in Studio and the audit, not on the public page).

personId.description: The person who wrote or approved the reply.

badge.description: What the public page shows next to the name: `author` when the person wrote the entry, otherwise `team`.

oneOf.title: ErasedCommentAuthor
oneOf.description: The commenter's identity was erased on request (RFC-0007 privacy model). Pages show a localised "Anonymous".

CommentLabel.description: An advisory label. `rule` labels come from the submission pipeline (word lists, link count, instruction-like text); `classifier` from an opt-in classifier (Workers AI, Akismet); `agent` from `label_comments`; `person` from Studio. `by` is the agent or person that set it (absent for rules and classifiers).

confidence.description: 0 to 100, when the source reports one.

CommentModeration.description: The latest moderation decision, kept as a statement of reasons (EU DSA Art. 17). The full history is in `comment_events`. Approvals are always a person's decision; agents may only hide, mark as spam or hold.

reasonCode.description: Required by writers for hide, spam, delete and erase.

note.description: Free text from the moderator, plain text, at most 500 characters.

automated.description: True when the decision was taken without a person (an agent, a rule or a ban), as a statement of reasons must say.

CommentOrigin.description: For imported comments: the system and its id, so importers are idempotent.

id.description: The comment's id in that system: printable ASCII, at most 200 characters.
